title: Best pool cleaner deal: Save $600 on Aiper Scuba V3
excerpt: Summer pool maintenance just got much easier.
content_html:
SAVE $600: As of July 27, the Aiper Scuba V3 is on sale for $799.99 at Amazon. That's a 43% discount on the list price.

Robot pool cleaners are a welcome assistant when summer arrives, and pool maintenance becomes a more regular task.

Designed to tackle dirt, leaves, and debris with minimal effort, they can help keep your pool swim-ready throughout the season. There are many to choose from, but if you're looking for an impressive model at a great price, then the Aiper Scuba V3 is currently on sale at Amazon. Normally $1,399.99,this model is currently reduced to $799.99. That's a $600 savings, and it's the lowest-ever price.

So how does it work? This cordless robotic pool cleaner uses an AI-powered camera system to navigate and identify more than 20 types of debris, helping to clean your pool floor more efficiently. Its Cognitive AI Navium Mode analyzes factors such as pool size, weather, and previous cleaning history to create automatic weekly cleaning schedules, too.

After it's done cleaning, the robot returns to the waterline and sends you a notification through the app to tell you it's ready. It also comes with a wireless charging dock that requires no installation, so when it's done, you can just place the cleaner on the dock to recharge and store it between uses.

夏季到来时，泳池清洁机器人成为了迎宾助手，泳池维护也成为一项更加常规的任务。

它们旨在以最小的努力处理污垢、树叶和碎片，可以帮助您的泳池在整个季节保持畅游状态。 有很多可供选择，但如果您正在寻找一款价格实惠、令人印象深刻的型号，那么 Aiper Scuba V3 目前正在亚马逊上销售。 原价 1,399.99 美元，该型号目前降至 799.99 美元。 节省了 600 美元，而且是有史以来最低的价格。
